verdict.rationale: pnpm is documented as a drop-in npm replacement with built-in lockfile safety mechanisms (frozen-lockfile in CI, dry-run resolution reporting, controlled checksum updates, audit --fix), all of which imply that adding/removing/upgrading dependencies is done via CLI operations that manage the manifest and lockfile automatically rather than manual edits. However, the evidence pack never explicitly cites the `pnpm add`, `pnpm remove`, or `pnpm update` command docs themselves, only adjacent install/audit/CI behaviors. missing for 10: explicit documentation of `pnpm add/remove/update` command pages showing manifest+lockfile rewrite behavior, and independent hands-on confirmation that agents use these commands successfully without manual file edits.
